newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Russian space probe lands in Pacific - official.
newsitem.headline: Russian space probe lands in Pacific - official.

text.p: A stricken Russian space probe carrying four canisters of plutonium came to Earth on Monday over the Pacific Ocean, Australian officials said.

Emergency Management Australia said the Mars probe, which ran into trouble after blasting off from Kazakhstan on Saturday, re-entered the Earth's atmosphere and came down near Easter Island at 31 degrees south and 96.3 degrees west.
The probe therefore landed between Easter Island and the Chilean capital of Santiago.
"The news is that it came down, 31 degrees south and 96.3 degrees west," said EMA spokesman Philip Stenchion.
"It's actually off South America, near Easter Island," he added.
The White House earlier said that the probe could hit Earth over Australia, causing Australian defence officials to prepare for a possible emergency.
